description: A request to redact (anonymize) the profile of the authenticated user. The user must have two factor authentication enabled and provide a one time password generated by the authenticator application, recovery codes are not accepted. If the user does not have two factor authentication enabled a 401 error with the TWO_FA_ENABLED_REQUIRED code is returned and the profile cannot be redacted.

otpCode.description: The one time password generated by the authenticator application.
